prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity flat desktop website UI design comp, landscape 1536x1024, no device frame or photographic setting. Product: WOODHOUSE public portfolio analytics across seven small products. Established visual identity: ink navy #080D19, raised navy #0F182A, porcelain #F4F7FD, restrained acid #E9FF49 with cyan #79D8FF, cobalt #647DFF and coral #FF746A used for distinct data series, no glow, no gradients, no glass, no generic rounded SaaS card grid. Bricolage Grotesque headings, precise system sans body, strong typographic craft, tabular numeric text, contemporary professional analytical software. Core screen title "Portfolio analytics", compact real top navigation "Activity / Projects / Share", native-looking project selector for All projects / Fighter / Bubbles / Protocol 11 / SHOALSHOT / App Composer / LoftwahFM / Woodhouse. Date range control "16 Sep – 15 Oct 2026" and presets7d30d90dCustom. Main chart must be large and detailed with axes, lightly ruled measurement grid, inspectable crosshair, zoom brush, a meaningful legend, and an elegant coverage boundary. No giant marketing hero. Show enough second-fold content to prove composition. Honest actual report numbers may appear: Fighter164 recorded starts,109 recorded completions; App Composer562 bounded opens and8 actions; FM1m35s audible listening. Label historical Fighter figures "Legacy · includes test activity"; say "No clean growth comparison yet". Never claim users, revenue, clean growth, popularity or NEW BEST. Visible "Design study · chart traces illustrative" so the mockup cannot be mistaken for a production report. Context pane answers "What does this mean?" and "What we cannot conclude"; measured browser reports are not unique people, capped opens are not conversions, listening is not gameplay. Native "Share report" button, semantic-looking small chart data controls, visible source provenance. Precise crafted charting is the central artifact. Large enough UI text to be legible, sophisticated density, strong information hierarchy. Design a complete ambitious usable analytics screen, not a poster. Composition C, "Project deep dive": left third is a fixed editorial project dossier with Fighter identity, source and explanatory metric definitions, legacy label and exact snapshot date; right two-thirds is a commanding chart workspace with date toolbar, primary starts/completions plot, a second active-play comparison plot beneath, and one compact calendar activity map. Top global nav compact. One obvious Share report action joins the dossier; sources and coverage are always in view. Strong spatial hierarchy with precise typography; rich charts feel like professional exploration software, not a financial trading terminal. No invented cohort funnel or decorative gauges.
